# Atlas dependencies and geography

- `d3-7.9.0.min.js`: D3 7.9.0, Copyright 2010 to 2023 Mike Bostock. https://d3js.org
- `topojson-client-3.1.0.min.js`: topojson-client 3.1.0, Copyright 2013 to 2019 Mike Bostock. https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client
- `world-land-110m.js`: Natural Earth public-domain geography in the world-atlas 110m TopoJSON format. https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas and https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

The land layer displays modern coastlines, not medieval political boundaries. Historical city markers use rounded modern settlement coordinates. Region markers are representative points, not assertions about capital sites or administrative extent. The authored corridors are simplified instructional connections, not measured itineraries or independent historical evidence.
